item.title: 🟠 Path traversal flaw in AI dev platform Langflow exploited in attacks
item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality system impact — check guest-facing services and PMS/POS status.
Attackers are actively exploiting CVE-2026-5027, a high-severity path traversal vulnerability in the AI development platform Langflow, to write arbitrary files on exposed servers. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 6h ago
